targeted_fixes.issue: Safari discovery succeeds but acquisition calls missing version parsers
targeted_fixes.change: Implement Safari browser and driver version parsers and typed invalid-version errors.
targeted_fixes.negative_control: All 19 added Safari regression cases failed before implementation.
targeted_fixes.native_proof: Final installed-wheel Safari tour: 12 passed and 3 explicit facade exclusions.

targeted_fixes.issue: Abrupt driver death loses browser-process ancestry before teardown
targeted_fixes.change: Capture original owned descendant identities after session handshake and refresh from retained living roots during teardown; no per-command process scan.

negative_control.result: Driver-crash scenario failed with seven surviving browser children; harness cleaned only its own identities and retained failed result.

targeted_fixes.native_proof: All four fault scenarios passed on final Chrome and Edge without harness emergency cleanup.

targeted_fixes.issue: Native browser timeout exceptions were relabelled as transport timeouts
targeted_fixes.change: Preserve Aselenium exceptions before the outer command wrapper handles actual asyncio deadline expiry.

negative_control.tests: Both real-loopback native timeout regressions failed before the fix.
negative_control.result: Both native sustained runs failed at iteration zero with SessionTimeoutError instead of JavaScriptTimeoutError; not accepted as passes.

targeted_fixes.native_proof: Final sustained runs preserved and recovered from 26 Chrome and 25 Edge controlled native JavaScript timeouts.

targeted_fixes.issue: Three docstring examples contained incorrect runtime instructions
targeted_fixes.change: Await the session timeout property, not synchronous options; retrieve previously cached JavaScript instead of caching duplicate names.
targeted_fixes.native_or_runtime_proof: 38 selected actual docstrings execute in their original statement order; 39 tests pass including inventory check.

rules: A passing status alone is insufficient: required scenarios, browser/version identity, durations, resource budgets and cleanup fields are validated.
Malformed or non-object JSON fails its gate while later gates still run.
Outer timeout retains output and attempts bounded cleanup of only observed owned descendants.
PID and creation-time identity checks protect unrelated processes; no process-name or system-wide search is used.
A failed library teardown remains a failed acceptance even if fixture cleanup succeeds.
Installed tours use independent output directories to avoid collisions between concurrent runs.
harness_safety.limitation: Cooperative process tracking is not a hostile-process sandbox: a descendant that forks and reparents entirely between polling samples can escape observation.

ci.unit_matrix: Linux Python 3.10-3.14; Windows/macOS Python 3.13; exact runtime minima on Linux Python 3.11.
ci.release_gate: Existing release workflow depends on the reusable regression/native workflow; publication remains explicitly opt-in.
ci.note: A committed/default-branch workflow and successful remote execution are still required; configuration is not a CI pass.

boundaries: All native results here are macOS 26.6.2 ARM64 snapshots with the recorded browser/driver versions.
Safari skips exactly frames, W3C action chains and concurrent sessions because its current facade disables them; PNG is tested but Safari PDF printing is not claimed.
Firefox passed its full feature tour; the new crash/hang and long-lived fault harnesses target Chrome and Edge only.
Browser HTTPS proxy fixtures explicitly accept their test certificate; verified TLS/authenticated CONNECT claims apply to the manager transport, not native browser proxy credentials.
Local two-minute sustained observations and configured CI ten-minute runs are not certification of multi-hour or multi-day unattended operation.
Native Windows/Linux, alternate channels, standalone Chromium/CfT browser bundles and WebView2 require separate successful acceptance runs.
Physical casting devices and deployment-specific SOCKS/PAC/WPAD behavior remain unverified.
Public website/CAPTCHA behavior is not a deterministic release test.
No Safari automation settings, personal browser profiles, system trust stores or user development environment were changed.
Edge auto-updated during this work; the stale offline cache was correctly rejected and a matching official driver was provisioned before final acceptance.
raw_evidence_note: Key measurements and native result bodies are preserved here. Absolute temporary paths identify original local artifacts, which may later be removed; hashes permit comparing retained copies.
